statisticalContext.sourceDocument: Sixth Economic Census of India — MoSPI
statisticalContext.ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
footnotes: Establishment = unit engaged in production/distribution of goods/services not for sole own consumption.
Own-account establishment = run without any hired worker on a regular basis.

glossary.Establishment: A unit engaged in production or distribution of goods or services not for the sole purpose of own consumption.
glossary.Own-Account Establishment: An establishment run without any hired worker on a fairly regular basis.
glossary.Persons Usually Working: Total persons usually working in the establishment, including the owner.
glossary.Hired Worker: A worker employed for wages/salary on a fairly regular basis.
glossary.Female Worker Share: Female workers as a percentage of all persons working.
glossary.MoSPI: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
